# tmux format variable names.
# Source: tmux 3.6a man page (man tmux), FORMATS section, the table after 'The following variables are available, where appropriate:'.
# Local package: tmux 3.6a-2ubuntu0.1.
# One name per line, sorted (LC_ALL=C) and unique. Lines starting with # are comments.
# Regenerate from the repository root (keeps these # lines, rewrites the names):
#   F=internal/integrations/tmux/testdata/tmux-format-variables.txt; { sed -n '/^#/p' "$F"; zcat "$(man -w tmux)" | awk '/^The following variables are available, where appropriate:$/{f=1;next} f&&/^\.El/{exit} f&&/^\.It Li "/{split($0,a,"\"");print a[2]}' | LC_ALL=C sort -u; } > "$F.new" && mv "$F.new" "$F"
